lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: So, Macal — after everything, why should Dune and Co. keep you?
lines.direction: calm, probing, slight South Asian accent

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Honestly? Because I stopped pretending to be someone else. I'm gonna bring the real me — and the real numbers.
lines.direction: steady, near-native, a small confident smile

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Bold answer. Let's see if it holds up when the offer's on the table.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Whatever happens in there — I saw who you became this season. Don't forget that.
lines.direction: warm, quiet, right before the door opens

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا يَا جَمَاعَة! أَنَا مَحْمُود، وَمَعَاكُم فِي يُلَّا فْلُوَنْت. النَّهَارْدَه... يَوْم كَبِير، يَوْم العَرْض وَالتَّفَاوُض فِي دُونْ أَنْد كُو. مَاكَال هَيَتَفَاوَض، وَيَقُول الحَقِيقَة، وَيِخْتَار مُسْتَقْبَلُه. رَكِّزُوا مَعَايَا عَلَى تَلَاتَة تَعْبِيرَات: الأُولَى... "To be honest", لَمَّا تِعَبِّر عَن رَأْيَك بِصِدْق. التَّانْيَة... "I intend to", لَمَّا تِقُول نِيَّتَك بِوُضُوح. وَالتَّالْتَة... "I appreciate", لِلقُدْرَان وَالاِمْتِنَان. يَلَّا... نِسْمَع سَوَا!
lines.direction: warm, energetic welcome, building excitement for the big day

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Take a seat, Macal. You've been here ninety days. Walk me through what you actually delivered.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Three accounts I turned around, a retention plan that saved us two clients, and the Rising Voices pitch. To be honest, the numbers speak louder than my accent ever did.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: And Tarek brought a bigger portfolio. Why should we keep you over him?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Because I know our customers who live here since forever. Tarek knows the market. I know the people in it.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Fair. Now — the fellowship. If we offer it, what do you intend to do with it?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I intend to build Macal Empire — a training hub for young Arabs who speak good English in their heads but freeze in real rooms. I lived that. I can fix it.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: That is a real problem. And salary — what are you expecting?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I'm not gonna pretend I don't need more. I'm asking for fifteen percent above my current package, plus the fellowship stipend. I appreciate what Dune invested in me, and I want to grow here.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Twelve percent and the stipend. That's my line.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Deal. And I appreciate you hearing me out — not just the résumé, the person.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: One more thing. Tarek is staying too. Can you two share a floor?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: We don't have to be friends. We just have to win. I can do that.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّب يَا جَمَاعَة، تَعَالُوا نْفَكِّك سَوَا... أَوَّل تَعْبِير: "To be honest". يَعْنِي بِصَرَاحَة، وَبِنِسْتَخْدِمُه لَمَّا نِقُول رَأْي حَقِيقِي، مِش مُجَامَلَة. مَثَلًا: "To be honest, I need more time."

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: التَّانِي: "I intend to"... يَعْنِي نَاوِي أَعْمَل إِيه، نِيَّة وَاضْحَة، أَقْوَى مِنْ "I want"، وَأَرْسَمِيَّة شْوَيَّة. مَثَلًا: "I intend to finish this project by Friday."
lines.direction: encouraging, slightly slower on the phrase

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَالتَّالْتَة: "I appreciate"... يَعْنِي أَنَا مُقَدِّر، شُكْرًا مِنْ قَلْبِي، وَمُمْتَازَة فِي التَّفَاوُض وَالرَّسَائِل. مَثَلًا: "I appreciate you hearing me out."

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: دِلْوَقْت... غَلْطَة شَائِعَة! مَاكَال قَالَ: "I know our customers who live here since forever." الأَصَح: "I know our customers who have lived here forever."

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: لِيه بِنِغْلَط كِدَه؟ لِأَنَّ فِي العَرَبِي بِنْقُول "مِنْ زَمَان" وَخَلَاص، فَبِنِتْرْجِم حَرْفِي وَنِسْتَخْدِم "since" مَعَ المُضَارِع. الإِنْجِلِيزِي عَاوِز "have lived"... مُضَارِع تَام، لِأَنَّ الحَالَة بَدْأَتْ فِي المَاضِي وَمُسْتَمِرَّة لِلْآن.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: فَاكْرِين؟ "since forever" وَلَا "for a long time"... مَعَ "have lived". وَكِل غَلْطَة زَي دِي، خُطْوَة لِقُدَّام! يَلَّا... نِكْمِل القِصَّة.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Then it's settled. Twelve percent, the stipend, and the fellowship is yours. Congratulations, Macal.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Thank you. I appreciate you hearing me out. And honestly, I intend to prove this wasn't a mistake.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: One last thing before you go. There's someone outside who's been waiting to talk to you.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: So? Did you take it? Don't leave me hanging, I've been pacing this hallway for twenty minutes.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I got it. All of it. Twelve percent, the stipend, and the fellowship. I'm staying.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Good. Because I've lived here for three years and I'm not leaving Dubai. I'm staying if you want me to.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Want you to? Nour, you're the reason half my sentences make sense. Of course I want you to.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Before you celebrate too loud — I heard about Macal Empire. A training hub for young Arabs who freeze in rooms.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: That's the idea. Why? You wanna compete with me?

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: No. I wanna co-build it. You know the people, I know the market. Together we're actually dangerous.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. That's the first smart thing you've said since I met you. We'll talk.

lines.speaker: Friend_F
lines.text: Macal? Sorry to interrupt — but your phone keeps buzzing. Someone from Cairo has sent you seven voice notes.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Seven? Who sends seven voice notes before noon?

lines.speaker: Friend_F
lines.text: A learner. Her name is Salma. She says she heard about you and she has a question she can't ask anyone else.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا، نِلَخَّص بِسُرْعَة...

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: اتْكَلَّمْنَا عَنْ تَلَاتَة تَعْبِيرَات:

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: الأُولَى: I appreciate — يَعْنِي مُقَدِّر، وَجُمْلَة زَي: I appreciate you hearing me out.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: التَّانْيَة: I intend to — يَعْنِي نَاوِي، مِثْل: I intend to prove this wasn't a mistake.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَالتَّالْتَة: have lived — المُضَارِع التَّام... مِثْل: I've lived here for three years.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَعِبَارَة الحَلْقَة النَّهَارْدَة... I intend to. لِأَنَّهَا بِتَخَلِّيك تِتْكَلِّم مِش عَنْ حَاجَة عَايِزَهَا، لَكِن عَنْ حَاجَة نَاوِي تِعْمِلْهَا فِعْلًا!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: لَو عَجْبَكُم البُودْكَاسْت، اشْتِرَكُوا فِي القَنَاة، وَادْخُلُوا التِّلِيجْرَام... هُنَاك بِنْتْمَرَّن مَعَ بَعْض كِل يَوْم!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَمَاكَال عِنْدُه سُؤَال مِن سَلْمَى... بِنْت مِن القَاهِرَة... عَايْزَة تِتْكَلِّم! هَل هُوَ هَيِسْمَعْهَا؟ وَإِلَّا الحَيَاة هَتِخْتَار لُه طَرِيق تَانِي؟

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: الحَلْقَة الجَايَة: سَلْمَى... وَالاِخْتِيَار الصَّعْب. يَلَّا، نِشُوف بُكْرَة!
